description: Mongoose plugin that intercepts document changes and writes an audit trail (diff history) to a dedicated collection, with AsyncLocalStorage context for tracking who changed the data. Supports NestJS decorators and Fastify hooks.
rules: History collection document fields are snake_case (collection_name, document_id, modified_by, created_at)
Internal functions and files use snake_case; the public API (exports, options) uses camelCase
Set modifiedBy (who changed the data) via runWithAuditContext or the framework interceptors
Register custom sources (e.g. 'kafka') with registerAuditSources before use; built-ins http/cron/cli/rabbitmq are pre-registered and unregistered values throw an Error
Transactions require mongoose transactionAsyncLocalStorage for automatic session pickup
